stories.title: Ex Ilva: Acciaierie d'Italia annuncia fermata temporanea Genova e Novi Ligure

en.title: Ex Ilva: Acciaierie d'Italia announces temporary shutdown in Genova and Novi Ligure
en.summary: Acciaierie d'Italia announced a temporary halt of operations at its facilities in Genova and Novi Ligure. Local mayors criticized the decision as unacceptable.

stories.title: Acciaierie d'Italia annuncia la fermata temporanea dell'ex Ilva a Genova e Novi Ligure

en.title: Acciaierie d'Italia announces temporary shutdown of former Ilva in Genova and Novi Ligure
en.summary: The company announced a temporary operational shutdown at its Genova and Novi Ligure sites. Local mayors described the decision as unacceptable.

stories.title: Acciaierie d'Italia annuncia fermata temporanea ex Ilva Genova e Novi Ligure

en.title: Acciaierie d'Italia announces temporary shutdown former Ilva Genova and Novi Ligure
en.summary: Acciaierie d'Italia announced temporary closure of operations at its Genova and Novi Ligure facilities. Mayors Salis and Muliere expressed that the decision is unacceptable.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, a Genova e Novi stabilimenti chiusi dal 15 novembre, i sindaci: “Serrata insostenibile”

en.title: Former Ilva, plants in Genova and Novi closed from November 15, mayors: "Unsustainable shutdown"
en.summary: Acciaierie d'Italia will close its facilities in Genova and Novi Ligure starting November 15. Local mayors received the notification and criticized the decision as unsustainable.

stories.title: Ex Ilva di Genova e Novi Ligure: Acciaierie d'Italia annuncia lo stop temporaneo

en.title: Ex Ilva in Genoa and Novi Ligure: Acciaierie d'Italia announces temporary halt
en.summary: Acciaierie d'Italia plans to temporarily stop production at its Genoa and Novi Ligure facilities by November 15. Local officials criticized the decision as harmful to workers, the cities, and Italy's steel industry.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, cos’è lo Stabilicum (o Melonellum) come voteremo e che cosa cambia

en.title: Electoral law, what is Stabilicum (or Melonellum) how we will vote and what changes
en.summary: Italy replaces the Rosatellum electoral system with a new law introducing a majority bonus for coalitions exceeding 42%, candidate premier designation, voter preferences, and thresholds for smaller parties.

stories.title: Tornano le preferenze, questa una delle principali novità della nuova legge elettorale

en.title: Voter preferences return, one of the main novelties of the new electoral law
en.summary: The new electoral law restores voter preferences and introduces a majority bonus for coalitions exceeding 42%, along with coalition premier candidate designation.

stories.title: Anne Carson vince il premio Nobel per la Letteratura "per la sua opera audace e creativa"

en.title: Anne Carson wins the Nobel Prize in Literature "for her audacious and creative work"
en.summary: Canadian-born Anne Carson, a classical literature professor specializing in Sappho and Euripides, received the Nobel Prize in Literature. She previously won two Griffin Poetry Prizes and the Princess of Asturias Award in 2020.

stories.title: Otto libri per conoscere Anne Carson, Nobel per la letteratura 2026

en.title: Eight books to know Anne Carson, Nobel Prize for Literature 2026
en.summary: A curated selection of the Nobel laureate's best works in verse and prose is presented as a reading guide.

stories.title: Chi è la scrittrice canadese Anne Carson che ha vinto il premio Nobel per la Letteratura 2026

en.title: Who is Canadian writer Anne Carson who won the Nobel Prize for Literature 2026
en.summary: Anne Carson, a 76-year-old poet, essayist, and translator, published her first book in 1986 based on her doctoral thesis work.

stories.title: Anne Carson, la poetessa premio Nobel 2026 che ha reso il mito classico in specchio del presente

en.title: Anne Carson, 2026 Nobel Prize poet who made classical myth a mirror of the present
en.summary: The 76-year-old Canadian-born writer, now living in Iceland, has throughout her literary and academic career brought classical themes and archetypes into contemporary relevance.

stories.title: Nobel per la Letteratura 2026 alla poetessa canadese Anne Carson

en.title: Nobel Prize for Literature 2026 awarded to Canadian poet Anne Carson
en.summary: Anne Carson received the award for her bold and innovative body of work that creates new forms for contemporary literature through playful dialogue with classical tradition, worth approximately 1.2 million dollars.

en.summary: Italy's aerospace sector needs to strengthen its competitive position in Europe and globally through coordinated effort between companies and institutions, according to Sitael's CEO Chiara Pertosa.

en.summary: Energy Dome has officially opened a manufacturing facility in Piacenza producing large domes containing compressed CO2 as part of its proprietary energy storage system called CO2 Battery.

en.title: Ranking of best companies to work for: Chiesi and Bending Spoons in top 100
en.summary: Hilton leads the Great Place to Work ranking, followed by AbbVie and DHL. The top-performing sectors include IT, financial services, insurance, and professional services.

stories.title: Data center, in Italia sono 262: capacità raddoppiata dal 2020

en.title: Data centers in Italy number 262: capacity doubled since 2020
en.summary: Italy has 262 data centers with approximately 45 percent located in Lombardy. The installed capacity reached 609 MW at the end of 2025, more than double the 2020 level.
